standard.summary: 选择训练缓存的存储引擎后端：off = 原版 npz/safetensors；lxfs/lynx = Lulynx 无损压缩引擎，提供更快的读写速度和更小的磁盘占用。
standard.effect: lxfs/lynx 模式完全替换 DataLoader 的缓存路径，使用自定义无损压缩格式（lz4fast/zstd 等）存储 latent，I/O 速度约快 20%~40%（取决于 SSD 速度）。
standard.whenToUse: 数据集大、I/O 成为训练瓶颈（CPU/IO 等待时间 > 训练时间的 5%）时考虑开启。NVMe SSD 效果更明显。
standard.avoidWhen: 小数据集（<100张）或 GPU-bound 训练（GPU 使用率持续 >95%）时，I/O 优化收益被 GPU 计算掩盖，提升不明显。

standard_en.summary: Chooses the storage engine behind the training cache: off = the original npz/safetensors; lxfs/lynx = the Lulynx lossless compression engine, which gives faster reads and writes and a smaller disk footprint.
standard_en.effect: The lxfs/lynx modes replace the DataLoader's cache path entirely and store latents in a custom lossless format (lz4fast/zstd and so on), which is roughly 20%-40% faster at I/O depending on SSD speed.
standard_en.whenToUse: Consider it when the dataset is large and I/O has become the training bottleneck (CPU/IO wait time > 5% of training time). The effect is more visible on an NVMe SSD.
standard_en.avoidWhen: On a small dataset (<100 images) or in GPU-bound training (GPU utilisation staying >95%) the I/O gain is hidden behind GPU compute and the improvement is hard to notice.

advanced.principle: lossless 引擎通过 lossless_cache_replacement_codecs（lz4fast/zstd1/raw）控制压缩算法；prefetch_depth 控制异步预取深度；decoded_payload_cache 将解压后的 latent 保留在内存（减少重复解压）；fallback_to_raw 在引擎错误时回退到原格式。
advanced.tradeoffs: lossless 引擎复杂度更高，首次缓存生成需要转换格式（比 npz 慢）；但稳态读取速度更快。对于 anima 大基座的 GPU-bound 训练，提升约 2.3%（端到端）；数据密集型训练提升更显著。

advanced_en.principle: The lossless engine controls the compression algorithm via lossless_cache_replacement_codecs (lz4fast/zstd1/raw); prefetch_depth controls async prefetch depth; decoded_payload_cache keeps decompressed latents in memory (avoiding repeated decompression); fallback_to_raw falls back to the original format on engine errors.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: The lossless engine is more complex and the first cache build needs format conversion (slower than npz); steady-state reads are faster. For GPU-bound training on the large anima base the gain is about 2.3% end-to-end; data-bound training gains more.
